From Tenore Sax · Price: the illusion breaks if a creature touches the walls to test them.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 2 actions: make an illusion of a 10-ft corridor.
  • 5: Surge: a creature in a 30-ft area is lost in the maze for 1 round (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates): it can only Stride in a direction you choose.
  • 9: Disbelieving takes a Recall Knowledge or Seek check vs your DC.
  • 13: Area 60 ft.
  • 17: Lost for 1 minute on a critical failure.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
